programs.salaryNote: NIRF 2025 median for graduates of 2023-24 (all 2-year PG programmes). The 2024-26 figure on iimtrichy.ac.in (INR 16,75,000) is from an interim, unaudited update, so it is not used.

salarySource.title: NIRF India Rankings 2025 - Data submitted by Indian Institute of Management Tiruchirappalli [IR-M-S-8948]

cutoffs.notes: Stated by IIM Tiruchirappalli as the minimum CAT 2025 performance for PI shortlisting (JAP 2026); 'achieving the cut-off percentile in CAT is a necessary but not sufficient condition'. (The table's sub-header lists sections in QA/DILR/VARC order, but all three sectional values are equal per category, so no ambiguity.) Lower JAP 2026 registration minimums also apply, with academic minimums Class X/XII 60% and graduation 50% (SC/ST: 55/55/45; PwD 45/45/45).
